title: Pilobol.us P3-04: create NEW CMS and reader apps from the template, GitHub App connect, first builds, release-gate checks
description:
## Goal
Create NEW CMS and reader Amplify apps for Pilobol.us from the template (repo-less, no token), connect the repo with the Amplify GitHub App, and get both to build from the packages. Release-gate checks happen here. Old apps stay untouched until the final ticket.

## Context (FACT, 2026-10-06)
- Old CMS backend is EMPTY (39 tables 0 rows, 0 media objects, 0 Cognito users); site is pre-production (Ryan). Fresh apps + fresh backend lose nothing and avoid every risk of re-pointing the PAT-connected, CFN-owned app d11eu9hbs2mipk.
- Old Cognito domain prefix papyrus-pilobol-us belongs to the old pool, so the new backend uses a different prefix until the old backend is deleted (e.g. papyrus-pilobol-us-2, or the same prefix after the cleanup ticket).
- Release gates: BRD exact brand id pilobol-us (PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND and NEXT_PUBLIC_PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND); PRV middleware runtime nodejs on WEB_COMPUTE; SCH schema on the fresh backend; convert-bodies not applicable (no rows, no Pretext article route for this brand).
- Console connect of a repo-less app works (PPY-a91e9c): it can flip platform to WEB and replace the service role: check and fix with aws amplify update-app --platform WEB_COMPUTE.
- Fresh backend needs secrets in the console (per app/branch): PAPYRUS_JWT_SECRET, OPENAI_API_KEY (any non-empty value if unused), GOOGLE_* only if Google is on.

## Exact steps
1. Ryan yes: merge the scaffold PR to Pilobol.us main (after the template ticket is on develop and the new package pin is chosen). Put the template output in: npx papyrus-infra synth --site infra/site.json; cdk deploy of the NEW stack (stackName distinct from amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us, no domains) with AWS_PROFILE=legacy. Record the new app ids; fill the reader app id into papyrus.config.ts and site.json (follow-up PR).
2. Ryan (console): install the AWS Amplify GitHub App on AnthusAI/Pilobol.us (this repo only); connect the new CMS app (branch main) and the new reader app (branch main). Check platform WEB_COMPUTE (CMS) and service roles unchanged. Set the backend secrets for the CMS app.
3. Start the CMS main job; watch (about 13 minutes); fix forward. Capture proof lines: npm ci, ampx pipeline-deploy, content-actions Lambda bundled with papyrus-newsroom==<pin>.
4. Verify on the default URL https://main.<newCmsAppId>.amplifyapp.com: /newsroom loads with the Pilobolus theme (Ryan eyeballs), / redirects, robots.txt, nodejs middleware works; aws appsync get-type shows bodyMarkus on Item and PublishedItem; Ryan creates the first admin (sign-up then aws cognito-idp admin-add-user-to-group on Ryan's yes).
5. The reader app's first build will fail or be empty until the CMS has content: expected; the import ticket fills it.

## Acceptance checks
CMS job SUCCEED, schema fields present, /newsroom works in a browser, brand id exact (unknown id fails a scratch build), production old apps untouched.

## Rollback
Delete the new stack (Ryan): nothing else depended on it.

## Risks
Python 3.12 via uv on the build image is unproven (+1 day); console connect quirks (platform flip); Cognito prefix clash.

## Needs Ryan
SSO; yes to the stack deploy; GitHub App install and connect (two apps, one moment); secrets; browser check; first admin.

## Common rules (Phase 3 Pilobol.us, simplified plan v2)
- Plan: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md (PR AnthusAI/Papyrus#128). Ryan 2026-10-06: Pilobol.us is PRE-PRODUCTION, Git history is the rollback, HARD CUTOVER: no soak, no Git freeze, no dual Git/CMS build path, no parity gate, brief downtime is fine. New Amplify apps are created from the template; the old apps and the old EMPTY backend are retired at the end.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, us-east-1 (SSO is Ryan's). Never print env var or secret VALUES (names only). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally. Creating, changing or deleting AWS resources needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step; deleting data or stacks is done by Ryan (or on his explicit yes).
- Never build in /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us (its build rewrites content): use a fresh clone or a worktree.
- Papyrus repo: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, feature/PPY-<id>-<slug>, PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. Pilobol.us repo: feature branch + PR, never push to its main. In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus only run kbs.
- Keep article text verbatim (the importer already does; narration hashes depend on it). The Auritus embed is origin-locked to the site key's origin; the production origin stays pilobol.us, so nothing changes there (narration will not play on temporary amplifyapp.com URLs: expected).
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link and command output when done.

comments.text: Google sign-in update 2026-10-06: Pilobol.us PR #47 (feature/PPY-97f03c-google-next12, NOT merged) drops PAPYRUS_DISABLE_GOOGLE_OAUTH, sets cms.cognitoDomainPrefix papyrus-pilobol-us-cms, cms.staging false, pins next.12. cdk diff: main branch env var PAPYRUS_COGNITO_DOMAIN_PREFIX moved/added and redirect URLs updated, staging branch destroyed (already missing, CFN delete succeeded), reader buildspec papyrus-newsroom dev12, StagingOrigin output removed; no app replaced. Deployed OK (17s). CMS app WEB_COMPUTE, repository and service role unchanged; branch main only; env var names: PAPYRUS_COGNITO_DOMAIN_PREFIX, PAPYRUS_CONTENT_SOURCE, PAPYRUS_EDITION_SLUG, PAPYRUS_ENABLE_*, PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS, PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND, SITE_ENV. SSM GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET exist under the main branch path. CMS job 2 SUCCEED, BUT it built repo main which still pins next.11 (papyrus-newsroom 1.0.0.dev11), so the pool us-east-1_vyTCcLVQK still has no domain and no Google provider (client COGNITO only). Needs PR #47 merged to main (Ryan), then a new CMS job, then Cognito/authorize verification.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Root cause (Cognito pool us-east-1_vyTCcLVQK has no domain or IdP): Pilobol.us papyrus.config.ts set backend.auth.disableGoogleOAuth: true. site-backend.ts uses `site.auth ?? authConfigFromEnv()`, so the config wins and the PAPYRUS_COGNITO_DOMAIN_PREFIX and PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS branch env vars were never read. Job 3 BUILD ran pipeline-deploy; the auth nested stack went UPDATE_COMPLETE with no changes. Papyrus next.12 code is fine. Fix: AnthusAI/Pilobol.us PR 48 (not merged). After merge, rebuild main; no new Papyrus release needed.

Google redirect URIs must use the actual domain. Follow-up: make the configured prefix take effect or document the auto domain and read it from stack outputs.

comments.text: OAuth return fix 2026-10-06: Pilobol.us PR #49 (not merged) puts https://main.dv0pdx67fk80m.amplifyapp.com/newsroom and http://localhost:3001/newsroom first in backend.auth.redirectUrls in papyrus.config.ts, root URLs kept second. Client (components/amplify-client-provider.tsx prioritizeCurrentOrigin) moves same-origin URIs first, Amplify uses the first, so redirect_sign_in_uri becomes /newsroom. Current Cognito client callback and logout URLs: localhost:3001/ and main.dv0pdx67fk80m.amplifyapp.com/. After the next backend deploy both lists become the four URLs (newsroom x2, root x2). infra/site.json PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS is not read when papyrus.config.ts sets auth.redirectUrls, left unchanged (validation requires http://localhost:3001/ in it).
